units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 24a:12">Snh. 24ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="N00990"><he>נֹעַם</he></cite> <cite ref="Zechariah 11:7">Zech. XI, 7</cite>) <he>אלו … שמַנְעִימִים זה לזה וכ׳</he> this refers to the scholars in Palestine who are polite to one another in discussion, opp. <he>מחבלים</he>.

senses.gloss: to sweeten the voice; to sing, accompany. Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ bot. היה מַנְעִים את קולו וכ׳ he sweetened his voice when singing, v. נְעִימָה.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> <he>שהיתה מַנְעֶמֶת בתוף וכ׳</he> she sang to the timbrel in honor of idolatry, v. <cite ref="N00992"><he>נַעֲמָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:1">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>מי מנעים זמירותיהם וכ׳</he> who sweetens Israel’s songs? David &c.; a. e.
